verdict.rationale: Goodwin has a dedicated Trademarks, Copyrights & Trade Secrets practice page. It describes trademark litigation, portfolio development and enforcement for named established brands and emerging companies, which covers brand enforcement as its own documented practice. Registration is only implied by 'portfolio development', and clearance is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance/search services, explicit registration/prosecution description, independent corroboration (e.g., rankings or client reports).
